\noindent\textbf{Parameter definitions.}
\begin{description}
\setlength{\itemsep}{0.25em}
\item[$\lbrack GCaMP\rbrack$] Total intracellular indicator concentration used in the model.
\item[$R_f$] Apparent fluorescence dynamic range (scaling factor mapping indicator state to measured $\Delta F/F$).
\item[$\Delta Ca_{spike}$] Per-spike calcium increment delivered to the modeled compartment.
\item[$ca_0$] Basal intracellular calcium concentration.
\item[$\gamma$] Effective first-order calcium clearance rate constant.
\item[$\gamma_{in}$] Rate constant governing calcium influx/exchange into the modeled intracellular compartment.
\item[$\gamma_{out}$] Rate constant governing calcium efflux/exchange out of the modeled intracellular compartment.
\item[$\kappa_{B}$] Linearized endogenous buffering factor applied to intracellular calcium dynamics.
\end{description}
